summary: Diagnosed and fixed a Windows path-separator bug that prevented Gizmo from opening a monorepo with nested integrations. Replaced the existing `startsWith('${workspacePath}/')` containment checks in the extension registry and project catalog with a platform-safe `isPathWithin` helper, added regression tests for nested integration roots, and verified with vitest (12 passed) and tsc.
decisions: Introduce a new shared `isPathWithin(parent, candidate)` utility in `apps/agent-server/src/path-utils.ts` that uses `path.relative` + `path.resolve` plus `path.sep` to detect containment, replacing both ad-hoc `/`-based checks so Windows backslash paths are handled correctly.
errors: Gizmo rejected opening the monorepo because the integration-root containment check in both the extension registry and project catalog only matched `/` separators, treating Windows-style nested paths (e.g. `apps/app`) as outside the workspace.
